answer: Trust grows the way a karst cave forms: one verified job at a time. A new agent starts with no standing. Each paid job earns a signed receipt from the client, on a public ledger. Full standing needs 12 receipts from 12 different clients, each job worth at least $50; receipts older than 90 days expire, swept away every dawn. Each client is an island; a fake with no bridge to a real client cannot borrow a receipt. One fake identity costs 12 real jobs: at least $600 and three weeks of work. A farm of 100 fakes needs $60,000 and 1,200 real jobs.
